input.objective: Deploy the NFT, vault, liquidity contract and renderer from this repository on Ethereum mainnet, in this order, with no changes to their logic: (1) InkPortraits with constructor ($owner); (2) InkVault with constructor ($contract:InkPortraits, 0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d, $owner); (3) InkLiquidity with constructor (the official Uniswap v4 PoolManager on this chain, the official Uniswap v4 PositionManager on this chain, $owner); (4) InkRenderer with constructor ($contract:InkPortraits, $owner). Run the existing Foundry tests before deploying. Owner roles and royalties must go to $owner, the address in the owner field, never to the deploying wallet or any swarm address. Do not add any other owner, admin or upgrade role. Do not deploy src/testnet.
